overallSummary: Fabio Giglietto maintains a strong professional academic presence across niche and professional social media platforms (LinkedIn, Bluesky, Mastodon) with a combined audience of 3,580 followers. Engagement is consistently high across all channels, driven primarily by announcements of research publications, open positions, software releases (CooRnet v2.0), and conference participation in computational social science and disinformation studies.

contentThemes.description: Announcements of new papers, research grants, and findings on coordinated inauthentic behavior and information operations.
Updates regarding software releases like CooRnet v2.0 and discussion around methodological approaches.
Postings for PhD opportunities, postdoctoral hiring, and academic calls to action.
Posts highlighting upcoming speaking engagements such as #DisinfoConf2025.

recommendations: Cross-post engaging academic recruitment opportunities to Mastodon and LinkedIn to maximize visibility among diverse academic demographics.
Incorporate visual media (infographics, publication figures, or tool interface screenshots) to further boost engagement on Bluesky and LinkedIn.
Increase direct audience interaction on Bluesky and Mastodon by asking open-ended questions about methodology to spark commentary alongside reposts.

platformInsights.bluesky: Achieves the highest overall engagement rate (avg ~6.14%) and high amplification via reposts, making it the top platform for sharing immediate publication announcements and opportunity calls.
platformInsights.mastodon: Serves as an effective channel for specialized methodology discussions and software updates (e.g., CooRnet v2.0) with solid organic reach relative to follower count.
platformInsights.linkedin: Generates the highest raw interaction counts (likes and comments), demonstrating strong professional authority for grant announcements and hiring posts.
